sites.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
sites.description: One per line, up to 500. A website (example.com or https://www.example.com): its sitemaps are found through robots.txt, then the usual paths. Or the address of one sitemap or sitemap index (ending in .xml, .xml.gz or .txt, or containing "sitemap"): only that one is read.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Maximum URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop after this many saved URLs for each entry above; no further sitemap files are fetched. 0 = no limit. Each URL saved is charged.

includePatterns.title: Only URLs matching
includePatterns.description: Optional. Keep a URL only if it matches at least one of these. Each line is a piece of text the URL must contain (/blog/) or a regular expression (\.html$, ^https://shop\.). Case-sensitive.

excludePatterns.title: Skip URLs matching
excludePatterns.description: Optional. Drop a URL if it matches any of these (text or regular expression, as above). Applied after "Only URLs matching".

modifiedAfter.title: Modified on or after
modifiedAfter.description: Optional. Keep only URLs whose lastmod is on or after this: a date (2026-01-31), a date and time (2026-01-31T12:00:00Z) or an age (7 days, 2 weeks, 3 months). URLs without a lastmod are dropped, and child sitemaps that an index dates earlier are not fetched.

includeExtensions.title: Include image, video, news and hreflang data
includeExtensions.description: Adds the lists images, videos, news and alternates (hreflang) to each URL whose sitemap entry has them. Off = a smaller, flat output.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most sites serve their sitemaps without a proxy; a few refuse datacenter addresses.
